title: Lineage change list, format v0
description: What changed between two states of one document. Produced by the Lineage engine and consumed by any tool. Public API: see spec/format/README.md for versioning rules.

specVersion.description: Version of this format. Always "0" in v0.

format.description: Document format the change list describes. v0 covers Word, PowerPoint and Excel.

changeId.description: Stable identifier for one change within its change list.

text.description: Text content, or null where the side does not exist (nothing before an insert, nothing after a delete).

kind.description: insert, delete and modify change content; move relocates content (before and after differ if it was also edited); format changes only formatting.

fromLocation.description: Where moved content came from. Required for, and only allowed on, move.

formattingOnly.description: True when the change touches formatting but not content. Shown separately from content changes.

confidence.description: How sure the engine is that this change is mapped correctly, as a whole percentage. Integer on purpose: no floats in the format.

summary.description: Plain-English summary for people, for example "'Data engineer' changed to 'Senior data engineer'".

category.description: xlsx only, and required there: which of the five kinds of workbook change this is. input: a typed value changed. formula: the formula changed, even when its result didn't. knockOn: a calculated result changed while its formula didn't. refreshed: data from a connection, another workbook or a volatile function. structure: sheets, rows, columns, names, tables, formats and settings.

provenance.description: xlsx only, and required there: why the change happened, as far as the evidence goes. directEdit: a change event from the editing session matches it. downstream: the dependency graph links it to an input or formula change in the same list, and nothing else upstream changed. refresh: a data refresh, another workbook or a volatile function. likelyDownstream: the graph suggests it, but other explanations remain. unknown: anything else.

location.description: Where a change is, keyed by format. Each format adds its own shape in later versions.

part.description: Package part holding the sheet, for example xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml, or xl/workbook.xml for a change to the workbook. For a macro, the VBA project (xl/vbaProject.bin); for a query, Power Query's custom XML item (customXml/item1.xml); for a pivot table or slicer, its definition.

sheet.description: The sheet's name, in the version the change is in. Empty for a change to the workbook.

sheetIndex.description: Zero-based position of the sheet among the tabs.

address.description: The cell or range in A1 style, in the version the change is in (the later one, or the earlier one for a deletion). Whole rows are 4:6, whole columns B:C.

addressBefore.description: Where the cell was in the earlier version, when rows or columns moved it.

target.description: What changed when it isn't one cell: rows, columns, the sheet itself, a defined name, a table, a data connection, the workbook's settings, a macro module, a Power Query query, a pivot table, a slicer, or a part kept but not tracked yet (charts, links to other workbooks and so on).

object.description: For the macro, query, pivot and slicer targets: the module, query, pivot table or slicer, by name.

part.description: Package part holding the slide, for example ppt/slides/slide6.xml.

slideIndex.description: Zero-based position of the slide in the deck's show order.

slideId.description: The slide's id in the deck (p:sldId), which survives reordering.

shapeId.description: The shape's id on the slide (p:cNvPr), when the change is to one shape.

target.description: What on the slide changed, when not a shape: the slide itself, its speaker notes, its settings (hidden, layout, background, transition) or its animations; design means the slide masters, layouts and theme.

part.description: Package part holding the content, for example word/document.xml or word/footnotes.xml.

blockIndex.description: Zero-based index of the block (paragraph, table or section break) in the part.

blockAnchor.description: Optional stable anchor for the block, such as a paragraph ID, that survives moves.

cellLocation.description: A place inside the table at blockIndex: a row, then optionally a column and the block inside that cell. Nested tables nest another cell. A row without a column means the whole row.

blockIndex.description: Zero-based index of the block inside the cell.

charRange.description: Half-open range of characters within the block's text, counted in Unicode scalar values.
